thread:
Tess W.: Quick results from resonance-9b bring-up (fp16 vs int4) on the long-answer-support slice. TL;DR: big latency gains, modest quality drop concentrated in chain-of-thoughts.
Rajat S.: paste the key numbers pls.
Tess W.: slice=long-answer-support-600 (avg 740 tokens). fp16 Rouge-L=44.1 / BERTScore=0.892. int4 Rouge-L=41.5 / BERTScore=0.880. p95 latency fp16=810ms -> int4=420ms. throughput +2.3x. cost/1k tokens fp16=$0.061, int4=$0.033. Hallucination flagged ~1.6% int4 vs 0.4% fp16 in auto-eval (n=1000).
Naomi C.: Which intents see the drop? any specific failure modes?
Tess W.: Mostly multi-step "account_reconciliation" and "policy_advice" where omitted premises cause subtle misanswers. Not blatant fabrications but missing steps.
Rajat S.: Econ back-of-envelope: site tokens/month ~180M. If we route 15% to int4 raw infra save ~= $6.84k/mo. Estimated extra support cost from regressions ~$2.0k/mo -> net ~$4.8k/mo.
Naomi C.: Product: we can accept some loss for discovery/ideation but not for reconciliations or policy. Suggest hybrid routing + small holdback + on-the-fly confidence check.
Tess W.: Proposed routing proto:
```yaml
route: long-answer-support
rules:
  - if intent in [account_reconciliation, policy_advice] then model: resonance-9b-fp16
  - elif (thread_turns > 6 and last_user_tokens > 250) then model: resonance-9b-fp16
  - elif model_confidence < 0.62 then model: resonance-9b-fp16
  - else model: resonance-9b-int4
fallback: resonance-9b-fp16
metrics: rouge_l, bertscore, hallucination_rate_by_intent, cost_delta
```
Rajat S.: Also propose a tiny edge heuristic (last_user_mentions_numbers OR contains_attachments) -> force fp16. Cheap to compute.
eval-bot: Auto-eval snapshot: sample=200 live queries -> int4 mean Rouge-L drop = 2.4 (sd 0.95). Hallucination flagged 3/200; manual triage reduced to 2/200 (1.0%).
Naomi C.: Canary plan: 72h 5% non-sensitive -> if stable, ramp to 15% over 10 days with 1% fp16 holdback and daily auto-eval. Rollback triggers: hallucination_rate > 1% for sensitive intents over 6h OR rouge_l drop > 2.0 sustained 12h.
Tess W.: I'll put together the GTN README, eval notebook, and a per-intent cost sheet. Link incoming.
Rajat S.: I'll add dashboards: per-intent hallucination, rouge delta, and cost savings. If edge heuristic catches >50% false positives, we widen to 25% later.
